title: AbelianHigherDirectImageFunctorComparison
statement: For schemes $X,Y$ in universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a morphism $h:Y\to X$, and $q\in\mathbf N$, let $B_X$ send an etale object $U$ to the sheafification of the free abelian presheaf represented by $U$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Define $P_{h,q}:\operatorname{Ab}(Y_{\mathrm{et}})\to\operatorname{PSh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\operatorname{Ab})$ by $P_{h,q}(F)(U)=\operatorname{Hom}_{D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}})}((h^{-1}B_X(U))[0],F[0][q])$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with postcomposition for coefficient maps and precomposition for restriction maps. There exists a natural isomorphism, in $F$, from $P_{h,q}$ followed by sheafification to $F\mapsto H^q(Rh_*F[0])$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. No compactness, separation, torsion, or colimit hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03Q8 (lemma-higher-direct-images), Tags 072W and 0BKV; coefficient naturality in the displayed presheaf formula.

proof.text: Construct the zeroth-homology comparison as a natural transformation from shifted Hom presheaves to the underlying homology sheaf. Naturality is freeSheafHomEquiv_comp together with map_comp. Transpose this transformation through the sheafification adjunction whiskered with the coefficient category. The existing local-bijection proof in AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf shows each transposed component is invertible: locally cycles lift sections and boundaries annihilate raw classes. Apply the local-bijection criterion and asIso to get a natural functor isomorphism. This helper is proved for an arbitrary site with sheafification, a derived category and enough injectives.

Construct two generic natural functor isomorphisms: restriction along isomorphic functors, and the additive Hom comparison of an adjunction. Their naturality is associativity and homEquiv_naturality_right respectively. Apply them to the free represented sheaf functor and the derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. The exact inverse-image single-functor comparison identifies their source with the raw higher-image functor.

Compose with the proved zeroth-homology sheafification helper. Whisker commShiftIso of the derived direct image by homology, and compose with homology shiftIso to obtain degree-q homology. Explicit functor associators align the parentheses. All comparisons are actual natural isomorphisms; the resulting Nonempty witness is proved in Lean and includes degree zero and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: Explicit functorial form of the represented sections and sheafification comparisons; read on the Stacks website.
